purpose: Acquire public Kerala transmission-network assets directly from official web-published sources without credentials or private-data requests.

sources.label: KSEBL geo-referenced power transmission grid v3.2
sources.model_value: Discovers public feeder, substation, generating-station and district layer files.

sources.label: KSEBL Grid Map 2026 user manual
sources.model_value: Documents the public georeferenced queryable EHT-grid map.

sources.label: CEA Kerala transmission resource-adequacy plan to 2034-35
sources.model_value: Current 400/220-kV system totals, interstate corridors, ATC/TTC, constraints and planning reinforcements.

sources.label: KSEBL public scheduled outage report
sources.model_value: Current public outage snapshot; useful as a monitoring source, not historical outage chronology.

sources.label: KSEBL Substation Operating Statistics (SOS)
sources.model_value: Potential operating statistics. Do not automate authentication or bypass access controls.

sources.label: KSEBL Transmission Asset Management System (TrAMS)
sources.model_value: Potential asset details. Do not automate authentication or bypass access controls.
